tests: Native queries Flex/DeepInfra/model/API in TR and EN; nonempty matching category; Flex retained after activation.

tests: Native940/1000/1440x760 at100%/125%: status>=160px and no status overflow, maintenance initially closed.

rows.evidence: Palette is a constrained flex column; header/search/hint remain outside the scrolling results region. Available height follows browser workspace.
tests: Native940x680 TRdark/ENlight at100%/125%/150%: palette and hint remain inside viewport.

tests/report817-folder-path.test.js: leaf/full value, no automatic copy, explicit clipboard API stub receives original value, close/focus.

Overflow proxy dispatch reaches hidden original dubbing button through existing handler (native picker/media action prevented by fixture capture listener).
